# Skye Canyon Home Expert
> Living in Skye Canyon, Nevada — homeowner and community guide

## About
Practical resources for Skye Canyon residents and prospective homeowners: HOA navigation, community events, parks, schools, amenities, and resident services in northwest Las Vegas.

Community guide by Dr. Jan Duffy, REALTOR® (Nevada license S.0197614.LLC), Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties.
